title: GOLDEN ENEMIES BOLT AND STAY
why: His g-21: Run, so you chase it. His g-22: No, it stays all raid. Watch: a fleeing golden may lead into machines or a dead end; slow howlers should still invite a chase and crawlers must remain catchable at sprint speed. Golden pillagers may camp near rings or walk in circles.
now: Hurt golden enemies run for 3.5 seconds at 1.35 speed, then chase again with a five second cooldown. They never extract, get culled, or leave with a convoy. Only death drops the hoard.
